---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Ringdown
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that Ringdown makes hard or impossible today? Describe
the situation, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If it's a UI change, a rough sketch or reference is
welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else — related tools, how you connect (SSH / Mosh / tmux), or examples
from other terminal apps.
